The header (p301-strip0.jpg) gives the refrain no syllable counts, only 'Ref.', so no metre fixes its lines. movedown:refrain.1.3: p301-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's second system, its one row: the moved word is a title of Christ printed with a capital, and 'I' after it is printed with a capital anyway.
